bias.en: Bearish · back at the September floor
bias.zh: 偏空 · 回到 9 月底部

read.en: AAOI fell 2.9% on Oct 13 to $97.78 and is down 25% in five sessions. It is below every average: the 5-day ($107.3), 10-day ($111.0), 30-day ($105.3, now turning lower), 200-day ($111.6) and falling 100-day ($128.0). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($130.5), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: AAOI 于 10月13日下跌 2.9%，收于 $97.78，五个交易日下跌 25%。股价位于所有均线下方：5 日（$107.3）、10 日（$111.0）、30 日（$105.3，已开始拐头向下）、200 日（$111.6）以及下行的 100 日均线（$128.0）。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线并位于零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$130.5），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The day's low of $95.08 brought the September floor ($93.6–97) back into play; it has held three times. Below it are $84.6 (March low) and $76 (Jul 29 swing low). Resistance is the 30-day average near $105.3, then $111–117 (200 and 10-day averages, Oct 9 high) and $130 (Oct 6 high and SAR). A close below $93.5 would open $84.6.
read.zh: 当日低点 $95.08 使 9月底部（$93.6–97）再度受到考验，该区域已三次守住。其下为 $84.6（3月低点）和 $76（7月29日波段低点）。阻力为约 $105.3 的 30 日均线，其次 $111–117（200 日和 10 日均线、10月9日高点）及 $130（10月6日高点及 SAR）。若收盘跌破 $93.5，下一目标看 $84.6。
